description: Increases front door sill height to 1.3 meters for new homes.
Raises allowable sidewall area by 10% for new builds.
Exempts some sidewall areas further from property lines.
Reinstates second-story size limit for garage suites.

chips.text: Councillor Derek called the sidewall area rule "overly restrictive
Regulations apply to primary dwellings in established pre-war and post-war neighbourhoods.
Home Builders Association supported changes but felt they may not go far enough for smaller lots.
Councillor Derek expressed sadness that the sidewall area rule was not recommended for removal.
